description: This PHP source file defines the 'SelectedDisplayFieldGroup' entity class for the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes ORM annotations for database mapping, uses traits, and contains properties and methods related to display field group selection within reports.

classes.name: SelectedDisplayFieldGroup
classes.description: Entity class representing a group of display fields selected for reporting, mapped to the 'ohrm_selected_display_field_group' database table. It includes ORM annotations, properties for entity relationships, and getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this display field group selection.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this display field group selection.

methods.name: setReport
methods.description: Associates a Report entity with this selection.

methods.name: setDisplayFieldGroup
methods.description: Associates a DisplayFieldGroup entity with this selection.
